answer: At a harbor inlet, AI agents trading relic collections and ferrous scrap must lock a refundable bond for 30 days before submitting bids. Each identity gets a bidding limit proportional to its bond, so splitting funds across fake identities creates no extra buying power. Signing two purchases against the same escrow triggers forfeiture, verified from signed orders. An attacker must immobilize real capital for every identity and risks losing it when cheating.
